role: Developer entry point for every gate, test and build task; `make ci` is the local equivalent of ci.yml, and gates.yml invokes many targets on Linux.
toplevel: Sets SHELL=/bin/bash, overridable SCHEME/PROJECT defaults, includes scripts/lib/xcodebuild.sh (defining XCODEBUILD_PINNED, the flag that holds xcodebuild to the committed Package.resolved), and a .PHONY list naming every target (including codemap-setup, codemap-guard, codemap-report and codemap-impact) (localization-orphan-guard appears twice, harmless). All targets are thin wrappers around scripts/*.sh, Tools/copy_linter/lint.py, scripts/generate_sbom.py, swiftlint/swiftformat or xcodebuild; their behaviour is in the unit records.

units.does: Runs `swiftlint lint --config .swiftlint.yml` over the repo; exits with SwiftLint's status (errors fail).
units.entry: `make lint` from a developer shell; prerequisite of `make ci` (Makefile)

units.does: Runs scripts/enforce_swiftlint_budget.sh: fails when the SwiftLint warning count exceeds .ci/swiftlint_warning_budget.txt.

units.does: Runs `swiftformat Emuqu EmuquTests --config .swiftformat`, rewriting Swift files in place (the deliberate, manual reformat the pre-commit hook refuses to do). Does not touch EmuquUITests or the watch app.

units.does: Resolves a simulator destination with scripts/select_simulator_destination.sh $(SCHEME) $(PROJECT) (defaults Emuqu / Emuqu.xcodeproj, overridable), echoes it, then runs `xcodebuild test $(XCODEBUILD_PINNED)` (packages held to the committed Package.resolved) on the scheme with that destination. No coverage gate, no result bundle.

units.does: Picks a baseline and runs scripts/check_budget_monotonicity.sh with it: BUDGET_BASE_REF when set and non-empty; else the merge base of HEAD and origin/main (printing which commit); else, when there is no origin/main, HEAD (printing that commits already made are not compared). The script compares every numeric .ci/*.txt in the working tree against the baseline commit; a raised ceiling or lowered min_* floor fails unless a `budget-raise-ok: <path>` trailer appears in the commits BASE..HEAD. With the merge base it sees raises committed on the branch as well as uncommitted ones; with HEAD only uncommitted ones.
units.entry: `make budget-monotonicity` from a developer shell; prerequisite of `make ci` (Makefile)

branches.effect: computes a default baseline (below); otherwise BUDGET_BASE_REF is the baseline
that commit is the baseline and is printed
baseline HEAD (working tree vs last commit), with a message that committed raises are not compared
